description: Conditions for a Hindu marriage (Monogamy, Mental capacity, Age, Prohibited relationship, Sapindas)
Restitution of conjugal rights. When either the husband or the wife has, without reasonable excuse, withdrawn from the society of the other, the aggrieved party may apply for restitution.
Divorce. Grounds: Adultery, Cruelty, Desertion, Conversion, Mental Disorder, Leprosy, Venereal Disease, Renunciation, Presumed Dead.
Divorce by mutual consent. Both parties living separately for 1 year + unable to live together + mutually agreed to dissolve.
Maintenance pendente lite and expenses of proceedings. Relief for wife/husband who has no independent income sufficient for support.
Permanent alimony and maintenance. Court may order gross sum or monthly payment based on income and property.
Conditions relating to solemnization of special marriages (inter-faith/civil marriage).
Divorce grounds under Special Marriage Act (similar to HMA).
Execution of unprivileged Wills. Testator must sign, attested by two or more witnesses.
Right as executor or legatee when established. Probate requirement for wills of Hindus/Buddhists/Sikhs/Jains in presidency towns.
Devolution of interest in coparcenary property. Daughters have equal rights as sons in coparcenary property (2005 Amendment).
General rules of succession in the case of males. Class I heirs (Widow, Mother, Son, Daughter) take simultaneously.
General rules of succession in the case of female Hindus.
Power of the Court to make order as to guardianship.
Matters to be considered by the Court in appointing guardian (Welfare of minor is paramount).
